test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.**

The annual meeting of our club has been _______ till next month.
solution: The correct answer is '**deferred**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**deferred**'. • It means 'to leave something until a later time'. [(किसी काम को) स्‍थगित करना] • *Example: She **deferred** her place at university for a year.* • We use the word '**defer**' to 'decide to do something later on (स्थगित करना बाद में कुछ करने का निर्णय लेना है)'. • In the given context it is referring to the** club meeting.** • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *The annual meeting of our club has been **deferred** till next month.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **dragged**: to pull somebody/something along with difficulty. (किसी वस्‍तु को ज़ोर लगाकर घसीटना) • **disrupt**: to stop something from happening as or when it should. [(किसी क्रिया को) विच्छिन्‍न कर देना, विघ्‍न पैदा करना, विघटन करना] • **deranged**: thinking and behaving in a way that is not normal, especially because of mental illness. [सामान्‍य रूप से काम करने में असमर्थ (विशेषतः मानसिक रोग के कारण)] e4:T720, The erroneous part is** 'either you will'.**
